standfirst: Fifteen years alone on an island, then a comeback attempt in a music industry that has moved on twice. Park Eun Bin plays it without a single note of self pity, and the family violence underneath is handled bluntly. These six are for the outsider learning the rules in public.

picks.why: A voice as the only asset somebody has. Same structure of raw talent entering an institution with its own hierarchy, and the same seriousness about training. Difference: it is a 1950s period piece about traditional theatre, and the rivalry is the plot rather than the family.

Music as the language for something that cannot be said out loud. Both use performance to resolve a family wound and both are unashamedly sincere. Difference: it is a time travel youth story, and the family relationship at its centre is a father and son.

Somebody brilliant learning social rules in real time. Same pleasure in watching a person who processes the world differently refuse to be pitied for it. Difference: it is a legal procedural with a case per episode and no violence in its backstory.

An island, a family with a history, and a comeback nobody is rooting for yet. Same 2023 register of warmth over unfinished business. Difference: the romance is central and the career plot is decoration, which is the reverse of this show.

Two siblings and the question of who was allowed a life. Same interest in the sister who stayed and the one who got out, and the same gentleness about damage. Difference: no showbusiness, and the structure is a swap rather than a return.

A woman losing the years she needed most. Same premise of time stolen and a dream deferred past its window. Difference: the reveal recontextualises everything, and the show is far stranger than this one wants to be.

against.title: Start-Up
against.why: The obvious ambition pairing. It is a founder drama about pitching and funding rounds; Castaway Diva is about a woman with no documents, no money and one skill.

against.title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
against.why: Named because both feature a seaside community and warmth. There is no industry, no domestic violence and no comeback here, which is most of what this show is about.

against.title: Doona!
against.why: Paired as the other 2023 drama about a former idol. It is a mood piece about a burnt-out star and a student, deliberately static, with none of the forward drive this has.
